bill_id.description: The supplier's bill it is recorded from: attach the tax agent's advice (and a certificate of residence) to it.

nature_of_payment.description: The nature of payment it is for.

note.description: Why, in the tax agent's words.
examples: Non-resident professional working on site in Singapore: 15% of gross

outcome.description: not_applicable: nothing is withheld (ordinary remote SaaS, for example); withhold: at the rate the tax agent advised; treaty: a reduced treaty rate, with the certificate of residence attached to the bill.

rate_percent.description: For withhold and treaty: the rate the tax agent advised, as a percentage of the payment before GST, above 0 and up to 100. Left out for not_applicable.

tax_agent.description: The tax agent who gave the decision.
